events.title: "White Album" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, "The Beatles," commonly known as the "White Album," on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Drop
angles.copy: It's been 58 years since The Beatles dropped their iconic double LP. Still sounds as fresh as ever, doesn't it? #WhiteAlbum

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we said goodbye to the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

angles.copy: A true turning point. 61 years since The Beatles delivered "Rubber Soul" and changed the game.
